messages:
dario: Quick follow-up from the all-hands infra section: can we get a concise explanation of the surge playbook and how prewarm nodes are treated during multi-region pressure?

chloe_infra: Short version: surge playbook = prewarm -> burst -> provision-reserved. Prewarm nodes are by default non-preemptible (treated like reserved) unless created with the 'preemptible=true' flag.

marco_ops: When two regions hit pressure simultaneously the autoscaler tries: (1) local prewarm/burst, (2) model-variant fallback (quantized), (3) cross-region if latency hit <= region_fallback_ms (default 150). We plan to make that threshold customer-configurable.

nina_product: On the console side we should show a simple timeline: In-region -> Model swap -> Cross-region, plus an indicator if cross-region was used on a per-request basis. Customers asked for per-request visibility.

lydia_support: For CS: how to report? Suggest messaging: "Request served with fallback: model_variant" or "Request served with fallback: cross_region (to eu-west-1)". Add a note about latency expectations.

chloe_infra: Implementation notes: eviction ordering uses weights (spot=0, burst=1, reserved=2). Prewarm_preemptible subtracts 1 from weight. Example: reserved_preemptible weight=1. We emit metric fallback.type and alert fallback.cross_region when it happens.

incident_bot: alert: fallback.cross_region detected, from=us-east-1 to=eu-west-1, model=redwood-8k-quant, latency_penalty_ms=120

dario: Action items: Chloe to publish a one-pager on eviction weights and node flags; Nina to mock UI indicator and expose 'region_fallback_ms' toggle; Lydia to draft CS blurb. Can we aim for drafts by next Thu EOD?

marco_ops: I'll also add a snippet to ops runbook showing how to force a region pin for customers that require strict in-region SLA. Example command: 
```
redwoodctl set-region-pin --customer-id=1234 --region=us-west-2
```

chloe_infra: Will add the metrics and alert labels to the infra signals doc and link here when done.

dario: Great, thanks. Drop PRs and doc links back in this thread. :rocket:
